notes:
New
• A redesigned Solis: solid graphite surfaces, stronger text contrast, one orange primary action per screen, and no glow or glass effects
• References: paste a YouTube link and it turns into a card with the real thumbnail, title and channel. Upload a video and watch Solis study it step by step
• A Reference Library page to save references and reuse them in any project
• New Project asks for everything in one sheet: name, footage, Cut Video or Fully Edit Video, video type, creator style, references and creative direction
• Projects is now a library of video frames, with list view one click away
• Opening a project grows the card into the workspace
• The project workspace: an edit map with every cut, zoom, sound, image and music change, an event list, and an inspector that shows why each change happened
• Revisions read like editing notes: Solis shows what it understood while you type, then applies it
• Progress HUD: a small window at the top right of your screen shows an edit's progress, current step and time left while you work in Premiere or other apps. Hide it any time; the edit keeps running
• Settings grouped into General, Editing, Premiere, References, Updates and Account

Fixed
• Focus returns to the right place after closing dialogs opened from a menu
• Sign-in, Learn, Feedback, Assets and Presets copy rewritten to say what things do

Testing
• Try the HUD during a full edit: dragging it, hiding it, and clicking it to open the project
